en.headline: AFCD launches special dog-control patrols with immediate enforcement
en.dek: Special inspections begin today and continue on 5 and 6 September at places where dogs gather; owners who fail to keep dogs properly controlled will face action without prior warning.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said it will conduct special inspections and enforcement operations across Hong Kong on 30 August, 5 September and 6 September to ensure dogs are properly controlled in public places.

A department spokesperson said officers will step up patrols at locations where dogs commonly gather. If owners are found failing to meet legal requirements, enforcement will be taken immediately without prior warning. The operations also aim to promote responsible pet ownership and explain the relevant legal obligations.

Under the Rabies Ordinance, dogs in public places must be kept on a lead or otherwise effectively controlled. The Dangerous Dogs Regulation further requires large dogs weighing 20 kilograms or above to be securely led by a leash not exceeding two metres in length when in public. Breaches are liable to fines and imprisonment.

zh.headline: 漁護署今起特別巡查狗隻控制 違例即時執法不預警
zh.dek: 署方今日及9月5、6日在全港多個狗隻聚集地點加強巡查，若發現畜養人未妥善控制狗隻將即時執法，不會事先警告。
body: 漁農自然護理署公布，將於8月30日、9月5日及6日在全港多個地點就妥善控制狗隻進行特別巡查及執法行動，以提升畜養人於公眾地方控制狗隻的意識，減少因不妥善控制而引致的襲擊意外。
發言人表示，人員會針對狗隻聚集的公眾地方加強巡查和執法。如發現畜養人未有按法例要求妥善控制狗隻，署方會即時採取執法行動，不會預先警告。署方亦會利用機會向市民推廣「負責任寵物主人」信息及講解相關法例。
根據《狂犬病條例》，狗隻在公眾地方必須以狗帶牽引或以其他有效方式控制。《危險狗隻規例》規定，體重達20公斤或以上的大型狗隻在公眾地方時，必須被人以一條長度不超逾兩米的狗帶穩妥牽引，違例可被判處罰款及監禁。
